title: Doty admits befriending Benowitz and misleading him

tellings.quote: then comes out and admits I befriended Paul that way. was tasked to do that.

plain: In the early 1980s in Albuquerque, an Air Force intelligence agent named Rick Doty befriended a local businessman named Paul Bennewitz, who believed he was picking up alien signals, and fed him misleading stories; Doty later admitted he had been tasked to do it. Michels tells this himself, in a conversation with the writer Greg Bishop, quoting Doty's admission that he befriended Bennewitz that way on orders. If true, it means a government agent deliberately pushed a man deeper into alien beliefs.
